question: Can other means of knowledge invalidate the Śaiva scripture within its own proper domain?
premises: Each means of knowledge has its own sphere
Contradiction requires overlap in the same sphere
Other means do not operate in the scripture's domain
inference: Therefore other means of knowledge do not contradict its authoritativeness in its own sphere.
plain_english: And in its own sphere, those other means of knowledge do not contradict its authoritativeness.
